description:
MeridianLink has made a company-wide commitment to AI. Claude is deployed across the enterprise, every employee carries an AI fluency goal, and leadership has funded a portfolio of AI investments tied to measurable business outcomes. The gap between a promising pilot and a system people rely on every day is where most AI initiatives stall. This role exists to close that gap.

You'll be the builder embedded with our business teams — Finance, Go-to-Market, Customer Experience, Services, and Operations — turning real operational friction into working AI solutions, shipping them, measuring the value, and making sure they stick. You'll work with direct executive sponsorship from the Chief Transformation Officer and the autonomy to move fast on reversible decisions.

What you'll do

Embed and discover

• Sit with one or two business domains at a time, learn how the work actually gets done, and surface the highest-value opportunities for AI — the ones that redirect hours, cut cycle time, or remove error-prone handoffs

• Turn fuzzy asks into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and a buildable MVP scope within days, not weeks

Design, build, and deploy

• Build production-grade solutions on Claude — Projects, Skills, Claude Code, and agentic workflows — connected to the systems our teams live in (Salesforce, NetSuite, Asana, Jira, Microsoft 365, our Databricks data platform, and internal APIs) via connectors and MCP

• Write the integration code, prompts, evaluations, and guardrails that make a solution reliable enough to run without you

• Ship fast with time-boxed experiments and small test groups, then harden what works

Measure and scale

• Instrument every solution for business value — hours redirected, turnaround time, adoption, quality — and report it against our enterprise AI scorecard

• Convert one-off wins into reusable patterns, connectors, and playbooks the next team can adopt

• Coach team champions so solutions have local owners, and feed what you learn back into our enterprise AI fluency program

Operate responsibly

• Build inside our AI governance framework: approved tools, data-handling standards, and the security and compliance requirements of a fintech serving regulated financial institutions

• Partner with Security, Data, and Business Systems so solutions are supportable and sustainable — never shadow IT

How we work

We optimize for transparency over perfection — a red metric is fine, a hidden one is not. Most decisions are two-way doors: we expect you to make them with your sponsor and keep moving. You'll get a weekly check-in with the Chief Transformation Officer and a clear set of outcomes, not daily direction. You'll be measured on what's running in production and doing useful work.

What success looks like in the first 90 days

• Three AI solutions shipped and in daily use across at least two business domains, each with a baseline and a measured result

• A starter library of reusable connectors, prompts, and evaluation patterns

• A prioritized, sized backlog of next opportunities co-owned with business sponsors

What you bring

• 6–9 years in software, solutions, integration, or implementation engineering, including 2+ years shipping LLM-based workflows that real teams use in production — not demos

• Hands-on depth with Claude (or equivalent frontier models), including agentic workflows, tool use, connectors/MCP, and prompt and evaluation design

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and integrating SaaS systems

• Working fluency with enterprise data — SQL, data warehouses, and the judgment to know when a data problem is the real blocker

• A track record of working autonomously with ambiguous scope, and of saying “here's what I shipped” rather than “here's what I'd recommend”

• Clear, direct communication with executives and front-line users alike; you can run a discovery session and a demo in the same afternoon

Nice to have

• Prior Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or AI implementation role

• Experience in fintech, lending, or another regulated SaaS environment

• Exposure to Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or revenue and finance operations processes

• Experience with change enablement — getting people to adopt, not just getting systems to work
